description: Runs all Cognigy.AI playbooks in a project as a regression test suite. MUTATING: This executes tests. Use dryRun=true (default) to preview. Returns pass/fail summary with failing playbooks highlighted.

dryRun.description: If true (default), lists playbooks without running. Set to false to actually run.

entrypoint.description: Optional snapshot ID. If not provided, uses the project as entrypoint.

flowId.description: The flow reference ID to test against

projectId.description: The project ID to run regression tests for

timeoutPerPlaybook.description: Timeout per playbook in ms (10-300 seconds, default 60)

name: run_regression
